instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched OpenStudio Application graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not run Ruby, Python, OpenStudio CLI, EnergyPlus command-line tools, shell commands, or helper scripts; do not edit OSM/OSW files directly outside the GUI. Use only OpenStudio Application GUI tools, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Two Room Suite Review and Save. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. The init.osm model already contains the required Office-A and Office-B spaces, story and zone assignments, paired internal Surface boundary conditions, and target geometry. Review the model in the GUI rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file, then save result.osm in the task output folder. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 2 spaces and 2 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Office-A and Office-B. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 12 OS:Surface objects, split into 2 floor surfaces, 2 roof/ceiling surfaces and 8 wall surfaces. The surface outside-boundary counts should be 2 Ground, 8 Outdoors and 2 Surface. Do not add any windows or other subsurfaces. Include 0 ideal-loads air systems, 2 zone HVAC equipment lists and 0 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 10.00 m in X, 5.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 50.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 96.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM satisfies these stated requirements.
